title: Acwa Q3 2026: profit +71% in the quarter, +0.6% YTD
sources: Acwa nine-month 2026 release (5 Nov 2026); Tadawul filing via Arab News; Enterprise, 8 Nov 2026

slides.title: Q3 profit up 71%.
slides.sub: Which number to read first, in 7 slides.

slides.label: Q3 2026 net profit: SAR 635.1M
slides.note: Revenue rose 32.7% to SAR 2.2B in the quarter. Tadawul filing, 5 November.

slides.label: 9M 2026 net profit: SAR 1.29B vs SAR 1.28B
slides.note: Operating income fell to SAR 2.55B from SAR 2.79B.

slides.label: Under construction across 29 projects
slides.note: SAR 30B of non-recourse funding raised in 2026. Total portfolio: 98.2 GW.

slides.title: Why the quarter and the year differ
points: Development fees are booked at project milestones, and Acwa says milestones slipped this year.
Funding costs are higher, and newly operational plants add financing costs.
Earnings will depend on when the 29 projects switch on, and at what funding cost.
